title: rosa canina var. rufescens
intro: Rosa canina var. rufescens, commonly known as the red-berried dog rose, is a shrub native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa, characterized by its fragrant, pale pink to red flowers and edible rose hips. The health benefits of Rosa canina var. rufescens include its high content of vitamins A and C, making it a valuable source of antioxidants and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Rosa canina var. rufescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
